criteria.detail: 56 files on disk, 0 unreadable, 0 steps built from a short window, 12 instrument-area-date-window cells dropped for short coverage and named rather than averaged over: ['B_L22_F_R_A_2240_EUR_N:IE:2014-05:win2', 'B_L22_F_R_A_2240_EUR_N:IE:2014-05:win3', 'B_L22_F_R_A_2240_EUR_N:IE:2014-06:win2', 'B_L22_F_R_A_2240_EUR_N:IE:2014-06:win3']
criteria.name: B97-1
criteria.statement: Every rate file parses, and no step is ever built from a window that is short on either side: a cell with a hole produces no reading rather than a reading over fewer months.

criteria.detail: 15134 of 15623 months stand above the published floor of 0.02 percentage points, which is four rates at half a tick of 0.01 each; the largest is 4.48, 224.0 times the floor. Six areas against the euro area, fifteen pairs each.
criteria.name: B97-2
criteria.rival_entailment: Under that premise the wedge between two positions is the same for every instrument, so the difference of any two wedges, which is a four-cycle over two positions and two goods, is exactly zero. It is read here against the grid the rates are published on, so the floor needs no estimate.
criteria.rival_premise: Each position carries one scalar, a country premium, and every price at that position is that scalar plus a term belonging to the instrument alone.
criteria.statement: The rival's point prediction of zero does not hold on the bank-rate squares. Passing means the rival is wrong here (`11e`).

criteria.detail: 1172 of 1296 months stand above the published floor of 0.20 percentage points, four annual rates at half a tick of 0.10 each; the largest is 7.90, 39.5 times the floor. 6 areas against the euro area.
criteria.name: B97-3
criteria.rival_entailment: The same entailment, on a carrier that owes nothing to banking: services are mostly local and non-energy industrial goods mostly traded, and neither is priced off a bank's cost of funds. The inflation square is a twelve-month log difference, so each index's arbitrary base cancels out of it. The square of the index levels is not used for this, because a base normalisation survives in it.
criteria.rival_premise: The same premise as B97-2, one scalar per position.
criteria.statement: The rival's point prediction of zero does not hold on the consumer price squares either.

criteria.detail: overnight deposits, households: 0 of 5 controls at least as big; overnight deposits, firms: 0 of 5 controls at least as big; term deposits <=1y, households: 0 of 4 controls at least as big; term deposits <=1y, firms: 0 of 4 controls at least as big; loans <=1y, households (placebo): 0 of 5 controls at least as big; loans <=1y, firms (placebo): 0 of 5 controls at least as big. Clean on 6 of 6 instruments, window three months. At the domestic dates the same count is far lower, which is what dates the move to this one.
criteria.name: B97-4
criteria.statement: At the date the cross-border edge was restored, the carrier's step in the wedge is larger than every control's on every rate instrument.

criteria.detail: Not adjudicable on this carrier, which is a statement about the instruments and not about the prediction. Every rate here is a bank rate and reaches the cross-border edge through a bank's cost of funds, so none of them sits on the domestic edge alone; the placebo moved more than the treated instruments, which is the same fact read from the other side. On the goods side the level object carries a seasonal cycle of about three log points a year with no seasonally adjusted country series published in this dataflow, and the one cell that pointed the right way rests on a margin of 0.13 percentage points over a control. Neither state of the prediction was reached.
criteria.name: B97-5
criteria.statement: A price sitting on the domestic edge moves when that edge is restored and not when the cross-border one is, and a price sitting on the cross-border edge does the reverse. Three states: separated, contradicted, and no instrument that sits on one edge only.

criteria.detail: 7984 rate observations on a tick of 0.01 with 0 off the grid; 9072 annual rate observations on a tick of 0.10 with 0 off the grid. The number of printed digits varies in both, because trailing zeros are dropped, and that is why the grid is checked rather than counted from the digits.
criteria.name: B97-6
criteria.statement: Every published value sits on an integer number of its own tick, which is what makes the printed grid usable as a floor rather than an artefact of the serializer.

mapping.B97-2: the rival's zero fails on some month -> PASS, the rival is wrong there; it holds everywhere -> FAIL, the rival is right there
mapping.B97-4: larger than every control on every instrument -> PASS; larger on some and not others -> FAIL and the reading is reported per instrument
mapping.B97-5: separated -> PASS; contradicted -> FAIL; no instrument on one edge only -> neither, and the record says so in its own detail rather than borrowing a verdict (`11c`)
